top_story.headline: No new FEC compliance filings surfaced since the last edition
top_story.dek: All 145 RFAI and Form 99 filings in the three-day window were already reported in earlier editions.
paragraphs: The window covers filings received October 22 onward. It held 145 RFAI (FRQ) and Form 99 filings, and every one was reported in a prior edition, so nothing new is listed today.

No red-flag keyword hits and no voided or negative transactions of $10,000 or more turned up in new data. The deterministic extras (Deadline Watch, Money Out, outside money and megadonors) also found nothing new to report. One data pull, the Schedule A query for large negative amounts, timed out at the FEC (HTTP 504), so voided and negative transaction coverage may be incomplete.

footer.coverage_window: FEC FRQ (RFAI) and Form 99 filings received October 22, 2026 onward, checked on the Sunday, October 25, 2026 PM edition.
footer.sources: FEC filings API; FEC Schedule A/B itemized transactions.
footer.known_gaps: NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day page layout changed (image, title and explanation not found) and the page returned HTTP 500, so it is omitted. The FEC Schedule A request for negative contributions of $10,000 or more (loaded since October 22, 2026) failed with HTTP 504 (query timed out), so voided and negative transaction coverage may be incomplete.
